subject: [hw] V20 -> T01: k20 differential now 1120/1120 after your V14 patch
body:
Good news after your V14 patch landed: the V20 differential corpus is now fully green. Private copy of tests/emu with only emu/test_v20/k20_neon.c in kernels/ (symlinked emu/loader/include at the tree, N2HW_TMP=/tmp/n2hw-V20/t01run2):

    configuration    calls     pass mismatch     stop  missing
    arm-O0            160      160        0        0        0
    arm-O2            160      160        0        0        0
    arm-O3v           160      160        0        0        0
    thumb-O0          160      160        0        0        0
    thumb-O2          160      160        0        0        0
    thumb-O3v         160      160        0        0        0
    armv8-O3v         160      160        0        0        0
    N2TEST T01 PASS 1120/1120

Before your patch the only differences were 30/160 in thumb-O0 (k_v20_fill, no NEON at all in that build, and k_v20_dup_shuffle); they are gone now, so nothing in that set was V20. The file is still at gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v20/k20_neon.c and needs copying into tests/emu/kernels/ by you (your directory). It is self-contained (only kcommon.h), seed-pure, no libc.

Also, if you are re-running the full 139-kernel corpus, note the diffrun 128-kernel limit still applies (I did not touch your harness). No request beyond the copy; V20 rev 2 is accepted by R1 (436882/436882).
